meaning.th: เสียง สุ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ซูชิ → สุ-ชิ

description.en: A spinning spirit with a little tail. It twirls like a top and leaves a spiral trail — enthusiastic about everything.

mnemonic.en: す looks like a spinning top with a tail curling out — it's always in motion.

meaning.th: เสียง เสะ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ครู → เส-น-เส-อิ

description.en: A dignified spirit that bows politely whenever it introduces itself. It reminds everyone of a patient teacher who never rushes.

mnemonic.en: せ looks like a person kneeling and bowing respectfully — a student greeting their sensei.

meaning.th: เสียง โซะ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ท้องฟ้า → โซะ-ระ

description.en: A drifting spirit that floats above the clouds. Its two sweeping strokes look like wind currents — it hums a continuous 'sooo' as it rises.

mnemonic.en: そ looks like two wind currents flowing together — a gentle breeze moving through the sky.

meaning.th: เสียง ตะ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: น้ำตก → ตะ-คิ

description.en: An energetic spirit shaped like a person in mid-stride. It moves in bursts, then pauses — like water cascading down in surges.

mnemonic.en: た looks like a person walking purposefully, arms swinging — someone on their way to see a taki (waterfall).

meaning.th: เสียง จิ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: แผนที่ → จิ-ซุ

description.en: A curious, swirling spirit that always seems to be circling a point on a map. It explores every corner before deciding which way to go.

mnemonic.en: ち looks like a swirling question mark — someone turning in circles trying to read a map.

meaning.th: เสียง สึ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: ดวงจันทร์ → สึ-คิ

description.en: A crescent-shaped spirit that only appears at night. Its smooth curved form glows softly, reflecting the moon it adores.

mnemonic.en: つ is a perfect crescent — the same shape as the tsuki (moon) it represents.

meaning.th: เสียง เตะ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

translation.th: จดหมาย → เตะ-กะ-มิ

description.en: A spirit that writes tiny letters and delivers them at sunrise. The hook at the end of its stroke is like a pen lifting from the page.

mnemonic.en: て looks like a hand holding a pen — the bottom hook is the pen lifting after the final stroke.

meaning.th: เสียง โตะ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

description.en: A light spirit perched like a bird on a thin branch. The small horizontal stroke is the branch; the curve below is its body, always ready to take flight.

mnemonic.en: と looks like a bird perched on a branch — the short bar is the branch, the curve is the bird's body.

meaning.th: เสียง นิ (อักษรฮิรางานะ)

description.en: A tidy spirit that keeps gardens in perfect order. Its three clean strokes are like the fence posts around a well-kept niwa.

mnemonic.en: に looks like two upright posts and a connecting bar — the gate to a garden.
